decisions.reason: Omitting the sensor-board level shifter does not change the requirement to hardwire the SPS30 SEL pin to GND for I2C mode.
The source retains the connected sensors and spare I2C/UART connectors and changes only the separate logic-level-shifting provision; the connector inventory remains unchanged.
The source does not alter the interboard power or signal connector types, pinouts, topology, or matching requirements.
The distinction between 5V sensor power and 3.3V-compatible logic does not change which power rails are monitored or the monitoring topology.
The decision to omit sensor logic-level shifting does not change the standalone regulator, its capacity, source selection, or the shared 3.3V rail it powers.
The source concerns level shifting for sensor I2C/UART connections, not the independently specified SK6812 supply and data-drive arrangement.
Omitting a sensor logic-level shifter does not change the established I2C pull-up values, pull-up location, bus speed, cable length, or optional series resistors.
The sensor-interface level-shifter decision does not affect the separate LED power cutoff architecture or MOSFET switching topology.
The source does not change the DCDC1 configured voltage, target rail voltage, or Schottky-drop compensation requirement.
The sensor logic-level interface decision is unrelated to the ESP32 BOOT and reset controls or their capacitance values.

Although omitting the level-shifter footprints saves board space, the source does not change any established board orientation, connector placement, alignment, routing, access, or dimensional constraint.
The omission of sensor signal-level shifting does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or normal-operation power path.
